about: Every input the forecasting package reads, with where it came from and the checksum of the exact bytes the committed results were produced from. data/ is git-ignored, so this file is the record. Run `python scripts/verify_data.py` to compare a local data/ against it.
verified_in: Python 3.13.16; checksums computed 2026-10-27 from the files the committed results used
caveat: Upstream URLs could not be fetched from the verification environment (network policy), so they are recorded as documented by the download scripts, not re-confirmed. WPP and WRP are periodically revised: a fresh download may differ from these bytes, and the checksum tells you.

required.stage: start state (WRP years), all backtests, mixed baseline
required.source: Correlates of War, World Religion Project v1.1 (Maoz & Henderson 2013), national file
required.licence: Correlates of War terms of use; see correlatesofwar.org

required.source: UN DESA Population Division, World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant
required.licence: UN DESA Population Division terms of use; see population.un.org

required.source: Natural Earth 1:50m cultural vectors, admin 0 countries

optional.stage: age structure (falls back to stable populations without it)
optional.source: UN WPP 2024 population by 5-year age group and sex, condensed to the columns used
UN DESA International Migrant Stock 2024, by destination and origin
optional.licence: UN DESA terms of use; see un.org

optional.stage: cache of the workbook above; rebuilt automatically if absent
optional.source: derived from the UN migrant-stock workbook by religion_forecast.datasets
Pew Research Center, The Future of World Religions (2015), country projections
optional.note: lossy: the mirror rounds populations below 10,000 up to 10,000

not_on_disk_manual.stage: the preferred 2010 and 2020 start state, via scripts/prepare_pew_panel.py -> data/processed/pew_harmonized.csv
not_on_disk_manual.source: Pew Research Center, Dataset of global religious composition estimates for 2010 and 2020
not_on_disk_manual.access: free Pew account; not redistributable here, so it is not committed
not_on_disk_manual.consequence_if_absent: the package falls back to the committed inputs/pew2020_start_state.csv (Pew 2020 only), and the Pew 2010-2020 test window cannot run. Prepare it with scripts/prepare_pew_panel.py when the workbook is present.

not_on_disk_manual.stage: religion of migrants, used to fit the migrant-sorting parameters
not_on_disk_manual.source: Pew Research Center, Religious Composition of the World's Migrants, 1990-2020
not_on_disk_manual.consequence_if_absent: sorting is fitted to the 19 published figures in inputs/migrant_religion_published.csv instead

committed_substitutes.role: 2020 start state when the Pew workbook is absent: the Pew 2020 composition as harmonised by scripts/prepare_pew_panel.py, committed so the package runs without a Pew account (formerly results_step5/headline_country_shares.csv).
hand-curated published figures (switching cells, migrant composition, religion-specific fertility), each row with its source and a verified flag; see docs/DATA.md
